mug-steam.note: Camera held. Lemon and mug stayed. No steam in the frames I opened.

mug-roll.note: Lemon rolled toward the near edge and rotated. Mug stayed.

rain-push.note: Street type held. Specific storefronts and the left awning were replaced. Not a clean push.

rain-car.note: A dark car entered from the left and crossed the midground. Street held. Spray was not clear.

door-open.note: The same door swung open and showed a brighter room beyond.

door-truck.note: The view jumped closer and the door opened. Not a rightward truck.

fox-turn.note: The same fox turned its head more toward the camera. Log stayed.

fox-wind.note: Fox stayed seated. No visible wind in fur or leaves.

probe_note: The 3s steam probe drew a thin liquid pour into the cup, not steam. It is not a board score.
